title.zh: Apple ML Research: Muse Spark Open with MLX on Mac Studio
title.en: Apple ML Research: Muse Spark Open with MLX on Mac Studio

current_state.zh: Apple ML Research demonstrated distributed inference with the newly released MLX version, running the ~1T-parameter Muse Spark Open model across a cluster of four Mac Studios at over 36 tokens per second.
